moderate.label: Moderate
moderate.verdict_default: Workable. Carry water and keep the pace easy.

high.label: High
high.verdict_default: Hard on you today. Break at least twice, or move it.

extreme.label: Extreme
extreme.verdict_default: This one we would move. Pick another window below.

assumptions: Shade is estimated from street-tree canopy density within 50 m of the route. It is not measured shade -- no city-wide street-level shade layer exists.
Conditions are hourly forecasts for this point, not sensor readings taken here.
The strain number models air temperature, radiant load, humidity, wind, your activity level and clothing. It is not a medical measurement.
Factor shares come from one-at-a-time ablation and are normalized. The model is non-linear, so they are approximate.
This tool compares exposure between options. It does not predict what will happen to your health.
